referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of Kenaf delivers the co-products 'kenaf fibres, at farm' and 'kenaf stalks, from fibre production, at farm'. An allocation was carried out based on economical and mass criteria ; UUID: 93114821-4443-3770-ad34-b3bb8b11ed93
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include the mainly manual cultivation of Kenaf from conventional production standards. Included steps are soil cultivation, pesticides fertilisation (mineral fertilizer), harvest, loading for transport and extraction of the fibres after retting process.
referenceFunction.name: Kenaf fibres, at farm

geography.text: Data from expert panel Indian Jute Institute and experts assumptions. India is the most important producers of Kenaf fibres

technology.text: Cultivation of kenaf from conventional production standards

representativeness.productionVolume: World production 2000: 0.51 Mio. t (China: 0.244 Mio t / India: 0.2 Mio t)
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Expert interviews, literature data and assumptions.
